entry.title: Environment · Mon, Oct 5, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Stormwater Annual Compliance Report. The City Manager highlighted the completion of the City's annual stormwater compliance report, noting accomplishments such as 10 citywide street-sweeping cycles removing over 1,000 tons of sediment, storm drain cleanings, inspections of nearly 29,000 feet of pipe, and outreach to more than 38,000 residents.

entry.title: Environment · Mon, Aug 17, 2026

Discussion / report: Staff Follow-Up Report on Deer Culling Program. The Community Engagement Manager reported on follow-ups to citizen concerns regarding the deer population, noting that Deputy Chief Crawley had previously presented on deer population growth, the current culling program, and potential alternatives.
